note: Each released tag's library SHAs (git rev-parse <tag>^{commit}). A row run from a library source checkout stamps the last built autolens_version (2026.8.17.1 at every later tag); when its device.provenance.library_revisions equal every SHA of one tag here, build_catalogue.py publishes that tag as the record's release_pin and library_version and says so in identity.software.release_pin_basis. Add a tag when a campaign measures on it. Version 2 adds carry_forward: a declared, human-ruled move of the records measured on tag 'from' (likelihood dataset_type in 'domains') to release_pin 'to' without a rerun, because the release diff from..to ('basis', per library) touches no per-call likelihood there; those records keep measured_release_pin and their measured SHAs, and identity.software.release_pin_basis starts 'carried_forward'.
